modern: To my own free will the free will of my neighbour is just as indifferent as his poor breath and flesh. For though we are made especially for the sake of one another, still the ruling power of each of us has its own office; otherwise my neighbour’s wickedness would be my harm, which God has not willed, so that my unhappiness may not depend on another.
